name: remote-hotkey-emulator
description: Control Windows emulator shortcuts from a phone over a trusted local network.

scripts.build:tauri-ui: npm run build:native && npm run build:web && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop-ui.json && node scripts/build-tauri-ui.mjs
scripts.test:tauri: npm run build:tauri-ui && node scripts/build-native.mjs --test-fixture && node scripts/test-tauri.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:desktop-ui && npm run test:tauri
scripts.test:cli: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:web && node --test dist/server/*.test.js scripts/web.test.mjs
scripts.build:cli: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:web && npm run build:native
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop-ui.json --noEmit
